To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the annotation of the gesticulation and the speech is a challenging task; (ii) there are differences in the annotation results of different annotators; (iii) the annotation of gesticulation is easier than the annotation of the speech; (iv) there is a strong correlation between the gesticulation annotations and the affective states; (v) there is no significant correlation between the speech annotations and the affect states.

(1) the annotation scheme is suitable for the analysis of affective states and gestures in HCI; (2) the annotation scheme can be used for the analysis of the affective states in HCI with high accuracy; (3) the annotation scheme has a low error rate for the annotation of gestures in HCI; and (4) the JestKOD dataset is suitable for the research on HCI.

(1) JestKOD is an adequate database for the analysis of gesticulation in HCI systems; (2) the annotations of the database are consistent and reliable, which is confirmed by the inter- and intra-annotators agreement; and (3) the annotations of JestKOD provide valuable information for analysis of gesticulations and speech in HCI systems.
